findings.issue: תִּקְחוּ is qal imperfect 2nd masculine plural: the addressees take the fronted prince phrase. Spanish makes príncipe uno, príncipe uno the subject of tomarán, so the princes are the takers and the 2pl addressees drop out.
findings.spanishSpan: príncipe uno, príncipe uno desde tribu, tomarán

notes: Repetition, singulars, לִנְחֹל אֶת־הָאָרֶץ as para heredar la tierra, and מִמַּטֶּה as desde tribu stay inside the tokens.
